_note: Redacted for hygiene (test-org names replaced). Gaps, scores and per_tile copied verbatim from the 2026-11-09 regression OEO blind grade (overall 85, faithful). Image paths and hashes are re-bound by the test.

element_titles_hidden.evidence: The only chart titles shown are the same section titles as the source (Net Revenue by Month, by Region, by Shipping Mode, by Customer Tier); no extra element-title chrome appears.

palette_match.evidence: Steel-blue lines and bars, light grey-blue KPI band and grey reference line read as the source palette.

composition_match.evidence: Title, five KPIs, wide trend line, then three bottom charts follow the source order; KPIs became separate cards, which is a small difference.

chart_shapes_match.evidence: Line with reference line, horizontal bars for Region and Customer Tier, and vertical bars for Shipping Mode all match the source families and tile count.

labels_legible.evidence: All category and value labels are readable; Shipping Mode category labels are small and the x-axis title sits at the clipped bottom edge.

numbers_formatted.evidence: KPIs ($199,739, $124,886, 1,313, 64.1%, 1.4%) and bar labels ($71,015, $89,555, 64.6%) match the source exactly; the trend axis shows fewer ticks and abbreviated month labels.

gaps.description: Trend chart y-axis has ticks only at $0, $10,000, $20,000 (source every $2,000) and x labels read 'Jan 2024' quarterly instead of 'December 2023', 'March 2024' style; the axis starts at Jan 2024 rather than Dec 2023.
Region and Customer Tier bar charts show a rotated vertical axis title ('Region', 'Customer Value Tier') where the source shows a small upright header above the axis.
Shipping Mode axis title 'Shipping Mode Category' sits at the bottom edge, partly clipped, and category labels are smaller than in the source, where the title is a header above the chart.
KPI labels and values are in separate boxed cards with centered text; the source has a flat band with labels above values.
Trend line stroke is thinner than the source's heavier line.
